title: Kissed Dense Thai Beef Curry
description: A resinous and dense Northern Thai dish featuring lean minced beef in a rich and aromatic curry sauce, perfect for midnight cravings, and ovo-vegetarian friendly.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add minced beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add coconut milk, fish sauce, and brown sugar, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Crack in eggs and stir gently to distribute them evenly throughout the curry.
Continue cooking for an additional 2 minutes, until the eggs are cooked through.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
